header: Reviews left after each completed consignment

reviews.title: Slot held through the December peak
reviews.review_text: We book 14 pallets a week out of Malmö and got all 14 in week 51, when every spot carrier we called had nothing left to sell.

reviews.title: Good driver, slow reply on one claim
reviews.review_text: Two crates of tiles arrived scuffed in October. Settled in eleven days, which is fair, but the first answer took a full week.

reviews.title: Chilled loads arrive at 4 °C, every time
reviews.review_text: Temperature logs come attached to the delivery note, so our quality team stopped opening pallets at the dock to spot-check them.
